programme.title: Venezuela, Vignettes of the Orenoco Mission
programme.desc: The Orinoco is one of the most important rivers in South America. It originates in Venezuela and mainly crosses this country with the third largest water flow in the world before reaching the Atlantic in the state of Delta Amacuro. This state is the second least populated in Venezuela, which is easy to understand since most of its more than 40,000 square kilometers is just water and forest. Capuchin missionaries arrived in the early 20th century and established the first missionary center, Mission de Caroní, in Araguaimujo, in 1925. Many of those who reached first died of malaria and yellow fever. Of the missionaries who arrived in the 1950s, few are still alive; however, new missionaries have arrived and others continue to arrive to support the work of evangelism.

programme.title: 13 Razones para amar la vida
programme.desc: No hay amor más grande que el que da la vida por los amigos. Jesús es el amigo por excelencia. Los amigos son benevolentes. Tu amigo te escucha, te regala su tiempo. Orando por ti…está trabajando por ti. Escuchar es un oficio divino. El amigo también conversa, del verbo versa y con. El dolor cuando se comparte con el amigo es más fácil de llevar. Cada amigo es la presencia de Cristo. Cuida la amistad. Otra razón para amar al vida.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. But Joseph's story is not just one of betrayal and hardship, it is also a tale of divine foreshadowing. His experiences and choices mirror those of the Messiah, pointing to the ultimate redemption and forgiveness offered by Jesus.

programme.title: Your Best Life

programme.title: Mysteries of the Messiah
programme.sub-title: Jason Sobel: God Keeps His Promises
programme.desc: In this episode of Mysteries of the Messiah, we delve into the lives of the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and uncover the hidden prophetic messages woven into their stories. We learn that God called Abraham to be a new Adam and Sarah a new Eve, with promises of descendants, wealth, and greatness. Isaac's name, meaning "laughter," symbolizes that nothing is impossible with God, and his near-sacrifice foreshadows the sacrifice of the Messiah. Jacob's encounter with the stone prophecy reveals the manifestation of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. These interconnected tales point to the ultimate Messiah.

programme.title: Live the Let-Go Life

As she listens to messages of God's grace, her faith is strengthened and she receives comfort from the Holy Spirit during her treatments. Her testimony serves as a reminder of the power of continuous hearing and the impact it can have on receiving miracles and living a worry-free life.

programme.title: Traveling Light

programme.title: American Trends & Lifestyle Episode 14
programme.desc: This week on American Trends & Lifestyle, our new host Lauren Makk gets into the Halloween spirit with a look at Orlando’s seasonal fun and steps into the magical world of Willy Wonka. Plus, Trans-Siberian Orchestra celebrates 30 years of rocking the holidays, author Nathan Moris shares tips for meaningful life changes, and we go behind the scenes of the adventure thriller Heart of the Beast. programme.desc: This week on an all-new episode of Coffee with America, host Sasha Rionda celebrates fall with a coastal California getaway and smart strategies for navigating the season’s biggest sales. We’ll also travel to Costa Rica for a luxurious escape inspired by coffee traditions and head to Hong Kong for a colorful look at its Mid-Autumn Festival celebrations.

programme.title: Training Van Tour: Kush Khandelwal
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor Kush Khandelwal tours the viewer around his van and its optimizations for training on the road.

programme.title: 2024 National Team Trials: Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: Lead Semi-Finals from Gaithersburg, MD. The USA Climbing National Team Trials for 2024 will take place at Sportrock Climbing Centers in Gaithersburg, MD from March 5th to March 8th. This prestigious event will showcase the top climbers in the country as they compete in three disciplines: Boulder, Lead, and Speed. The two highest-ranked U.S. athletes will earn a coveted spot on the U.S. National Team for 2024, allowing them to compete on the IFSC World Cup circuit. Some may even have the chance to compete in the Olympic Qualifying Series, where they will vie for additional spots on Team USA.

programme.title: Beneath The Ice
programme.desc: A story of curiosity, exploration and climate research inside the Greenland ice cap. Canadian adventurer, Will Gadd, uses his ice climbing skills to lead a scientific expedition into a previously unexplored territory beneath the ice sheet.

programme.title: Essential Self-Rescue for Climbers: Rappelling and Passing Knots CLIMB 18 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn basic self-rescue skills, and how to think critically in a climbing emergency. In this episode, guide and search-and-rescue pro Karsten Delap teaches you how to rappel in different situations as well as pass the knot in an emergency.

programme.title: Speaking out Against Bullying
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian's Tuesday plans are turned upside down when she has to return from a climbing trip to Nice in order to see her grandmother before she passes. During an already trying week, Sasha is tested by cyber bullying and makes the courageous choice to address the issue head on.

programme.title: 2024 Paraclimbing Finals: Session One | USA Climbing
programme.desc: Paraclimbing Finals: Session One from Gaithersburg, MD. USA Climbing will hold the 2024 Paraclimbing Nationals Championships on March 9-10 at Sportrock Climbing Center Rio in Gaithersburg, MD. Paraclimbing National Championships will be a two-round competition hosting a modified redpoint qualification round on day one and an onsight final round on day two. The climbing will be executed on top rope.

programme.title: Intro to Trad: Safe Descents CLIMB 14 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Ease your way into trad climbing, and safely open up a ton of new terrain for you and your partner. In this episode, IFMGA guides Rob Coppolillo and Marc Chauvin take you through rappelling, lowering, and how to handle special situations.

programme.title: International Paralympic Committee Selects 2028 Medal Events
programme.desc: Reporting on the recent International Paralympic Committee's announcement of its choice medal events in the upcoming 2028 inaugural Paralympic climbing competitions. Some selections/omissions were surprising to Paralympic hopefuls. Voiceover from Climbing contributor Suzie Hodges Irby, footage from IFSC paraclimbing competitions, and remote interviews with athletes Emeline Lakrout, Mo Beck, and Ben Mayforth.

programme.title: Episode 7 | Weekend Whipper | Singularity
programme.desc: In a UGC clip, climber Mou Ding is on "Singularity" (5.12b) when his second-to-last draw pops out of his rope. Jeff Jaramillo, Head of Gear Education and Outreach at Weigh My Rack, reacts to the clip and offers his takeaways over a remote video interview, pointing out the open gate in the carabiner, as seen in the footage.

programme.title: 2025 National Team Trials: Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2025 National Team Trials: Lead Semi-Finals. The 2025 National Team Trials Presented by YETI kick off in Mesa Rim in Austin, TX! 117 registered athletes will compete for spots on the Boulder, Lead, and Speed National Teams, with the opportunity to represent the USA at international World Cups.

programme.title: 2025 National Team Trials: Boulder Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2025 National Team Trials: Boulder Finals. The 2025 National Team Trials Presented by YETI kick off in Mesa Rim in Austin, TX! 117 registered athletes will compete for spots on the Boulder, Lead, and Speed National Teams, with the opportunity to represent the USA at international World Cups.

programme.title: First Female Ascent and Exploration in Cuba
programme.desc: Sasha and friends are in Cuba for some jungle sport climbing!

programme.title: Beckett Hsin Sends V17 at 16 Years Old
programme.desc: Last week, on February 24, 16-year-old Beckett Hsin became the youngest person in the world to send the hardest confirmed grade in bouldering when he topped out on No One Mourns the Wicked (V17) in Thunder Ridge, Colorado. Here, he discusses his "boulder his age" challenge that he started when he was just 12 years old.

programme.title: Are You a Dancer or a Fighter?
programme.desc: Climbing Coach Casey Elliot explains that there are two types of climbers: the try-hard, onsighting Fighters and the meticulous, projecting Dancers. Casey explains how he and his "Dancer" climbing friend came up with this revelation and gives the advice that pushing yourself to channel both styles of climbing will help you become a more balanced climber.

programme.title: Climbing Holds... Made Out of Mushrooms
programme.desc: Climbing Editor-in-Chief Maya Silver recounts speaking with Marta Agueda and Manuela Garcia, the founders of MAD, about their sustainable climbing holds made out of the roots of mushrooms in Berlin. As approximately 7 million plastic climbing holds end up in the landfill every year, these European game changers are forging a more sustainable path for the future of gyms. Read the full story here: https://www.climbing.com/culture-climbing/sustainable-climbing-holds-mushrooms-bioresins-recycled-plastic/

programme.title: Climbing's Newest Hotbed | No Days Off
programme.desc: Sasha travels to Manikia, a small village in Greece, to experience an emerging climbing destination. Manikia has only recently come into the spotlight as a potential world-class climbing destination. Sasha is joined on this adventure by fellow climbers from the Petzl team. The ultimate goal is to help establish a new climbing area the right way. During this trip, Sasha and the team set new routes in calibration with local climbers and guides while discussing ecotourism's positive and negative effects on local communities.

programme.title: How to Make a Solid Tape Glove
programme.desc: Professional climber and Climbing Contributor Genevive Walker demonstrates how to make a quality tape glove to use while crack climbing. She includes pro tips like the fact that tape gloves can be reused, if the tape is removed carefully!

programme.title: How to Climb in the Steeps
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor and professional climber Genevive Walker gives tips and tricks for climbing in the steeps, demonstrating proper foot placement, core engagement, and more.

programme.title: Episode 6 | Weekend Whipper | Ripping Cams in a Swedish Finger Crack
programme.desc: Climber Fay Manners takes a fall on "Trampoline"(5.11b) in Bohuslän, Sweden, in this week's Weekend Whipper, ripping out a cam in a finger crack.

programme.title: A Guide to Climber Skincare
programme.desc: Professional climber and Climbing contributor Genevive Walker does a show-and-tell with her favorite skincare products that are useful for climbers. She covers antihydral, Rhino Dry spray, Rhino Split+ (a hyaluronic acid cream), Rhino Spit (an aloe-based spray), Rhino Repair, and the importance of tape and of filing down calluses.

programme.title: How I Deal with the Fear of Falling in the Gym
programme.desc: Avianna Frady, Instagram-popular climber @climbwithavi, shares how she deals with the fear of falling in the gym. Falling can be intimidating, especially during dynos, but she makes herself practice falling so that she gets comfortable with it and can try big moves.

programme.title: The Blind Ascensionist
programme.desc: At 14, Justin Salas lost his vision but not his inner drive for adventure. This thrill seeker will take us on a journey of learning to navigate our world legally blind while pushing past any barrier or boulder in his way en route to becoming a World Champion Climber who continues to pursue a new challenge at every turn. Through Justin’s narration, viewers will be drawn into his mindset as he navigates through his physical, mental, and emotional barriers, only to find the strength to push past any “boulders” put in front of him. When Justin lost sight, climbing helped him build resilience and relationships as he found his place in the world as a blind young adult, and now he shows the world how he sees it.

programme.title: Climbing Switzerland’s Luzzone Dam
programme.desc: Two women climb the tallest artificial climbing route in the world, the Luzzone Dam. Standing at 541 feet tall, the dam is great for those experienced in multi-pitch routes, or can be top-roped by booking a guide. The climb is described as exposed and ridiculously fun with great views. Get the full guide to climbing the dam here: https://www.climbing.com/travel/climbing-luzzone-dam/

programme.title: Grim Ripper: The Scariest Gear Fails
programme.desc: In this Halloween-themed episode of Weekend Whipper, a bunch of climbers scream as they take giant falls, the result of various gear failures.

programme.title: YETI Climbing National Championships 2026 - Boulder Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The USA Climbing 2026 National Championships for Youth (YETI Nationals) at High Point Climbing and Fitness in Orlando, FL, bringing together top young climbers for Boulder, Lead, and Speed events to crown national champions and select athletes for national teams, showcasing Florida's competitive climbing scene.

programme.title: The Future of Fashion | No Days Off
programme.desc: Sasha meets up with professional Kiteboarder and swimwear designer Sensi Graves to hear what makes Sensi's business specializing in fashion. Sensi Graves is a self-made entrepreneur who started her sustainable swimwear brand - her materials are made from 100% recycled ocean plastics and reclaimed fishing nets. To round out this Oregon adventure and get the whole Hood River experience, Sasha and Sensi decide to trade sports for a day - Sasha tries kiteboarding for the first time, and Sensi tries her hand at climbing.

programme.title: Inside the Brazilian Climber Girl's Van-Meets-Gear-Closet
programme.desc: Professional climber and climbing guide Gisely Ferraz (@brazilianclimbergirl on her popular Instagram account) shows how she optimizes her camper van to store her climbing gear.

programme.title: Peak Exclusive Trailer
programme.desc: An exclusive clip of Peak, a cooperative climbing video game published by Aggro Crab and Landfall, is available on Steam. The game supports up to four players, and the goal is to get to the top of a mountain after crash landing on an island.

programme.title: Yoga for Climbers: Yoga to Prevent Injuries and Control Breathing CLIMB 25 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Whether you're a veteran big waller, casual gym climber, or just getting started, doing yoga will help you send. In this episode, pro climber and yoga instructor Heidi Wirtz will help prevent injuries and control your breathing.

programme.title: Training and Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian returns to Boulder from Toronto. She works out at home and shows us a new green juice recipe.

programme.title: 2 Skills to Prevent Multi-pitch Accidents
programme.desc: Climbing contributor Nathan Conroy walks viewers through the SERENE method of building a trad anchor. He demonstrates how to rappel without a belay device using three locking carabiners and a prussik. Read the story: https://www.climbing.com/skills/multi-pitch-techniques-to-prevent-accidents-and-get-yourself-off-the-wall/

programme.title: Episode 11, Weekend Whipper: Slab Slide
programme.desc: This Weekend Whipper features a UGC clip of an slab free climbing fall, saved only by grabbing onto an anchor further down the route.

programme.title: Climbing in Boulder
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian spends the morning in Boulder working Thunder Muscle, a 5.14a nestled between the Flatirons. Then she races back to town, packs a bag and catches a flight to San Francisco for a photoshoot with her newest sponsor, Tiger Balm.

programme.title: Dear Mother
programme.desc: Climber and transracial Asian-American, Cody Kaemmerlen, searches for a connection with his birth parents after a near-death fall leaves him shaken and grasping for answers.

programme.title: Veronica Chik - 'Fish Eye' (8c)
programme.desc: Nine-year-old Chinese climber Veronica Chik sends 'Fish Eye' (5.14b; 8c) in Oliana Spain, becoming the world's youngest person to successfully climb the grade. Watch Chik send the route and talk about her love of the sport.

programme.title: 2025 National Team Trials: Boulder Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2025 National Team Trials: Boulder Semi-Finals. The 2025 National Team Trials Presented by YETI kick off in Mesa Rim in Austin, TX! 117 registered athletes will compete for spots on the Boulder, Lead, and Speed National Teams, with the opportunity to represent the USA at international World Cups.

programme.title: Episode 17, Weekend Whipper: Falling Climber Gets Saved at the Last Second
programme.desc: In this Weekend Whipper, climber Avery Lieu falls while climbing Scary Monsters (5.12a) in Joshua Tree National Park, hitting the rope on the way down.

programme.title: Red Flags: Bolts and Fixed Anchors
programme.desc: Chris Brown, Pro Anchor Maintenance Crew at Salt Lake Climbers Alliance, explains what he looks for when performing maintenance on bolts and fixed anchors. He uses a magnet to test the metal, and looks to see if there is rust, corrosion, bending, or if an anchor is loose. Stainless steel glue-in bolts are the new highest quality standard.

programme.title: Best Big Wave Caught by a Woman? Historic Jaws Surfing
programme.desc: Debates were made whether or not the unusual angle of swell would work at Jaws. After a historic few days of surfing and arguably the best big wave ever caught by a woman, we'll let the images do the talking.

programme.title: Melissa Arnot: The Reason I Guide
programme.desc: Melissa Arnot has summited Mt. Everest more than any Americna woman. As a mountain guide she loves to see someone experience the mountain the first time.

programme.title: Cutting Lines | Salomon TV

We’re sharing the dreams of Olympic ambitions and the resolve of adaptive athletes. Follow big mountain skiers Marcus Caston and Connery Lundin on a road trip of a lifetime up to Alaska. programme.title: Warren Miller's Wintervention (2010)
programme.desc: Narrated by skiing icon Jonny Moseley, Warren Miller Entertainment’s 61st film – Warren Miller’s Wintervention – features acute cases of classic snow-diction from across the globe. There are the skiers who sail from Argentina to Antarctica searching for some of the last untouched descents on Earth. There are the skiers and riders who venture deep into the Caucasus Mountains of Georgia, chasing rumors they overheard in a language they don't speak and there are the skiers who tour far into the northern reaches of the Arctic Circle where they won't just climb peaks, they'll get their powder fix at the top of the planet. Featuring everything from terrain parks and lift-accessed fresh to the most exotic settings imaginable, Wintervention is the definitive solution for the snow-obsessed. Wintervention highlights the most trusted names in ripping – boards-certified riders like Chris Davenport, JJ Thomas, Lindsey Vonn and Hugo Harrison – and top young talent in the field – innovators like Andy Mahre, Jossi Wells and Zach Black.

programme.title: House on Haunted Hill
programme.desc: A millionaire offers ten thousand dollars to five people if they agree to stay overnight in a large, spooky, rented house. When you consider that the millionaire is Vincent Price, and the film is directed by Schlock master William Castle, you can bet the five guests are in for a long, bumpy night. This super shocker of the century was a smash hit upon its 1959 release. For architecture buffs, the home used for the exteriors of the haunted house was actually designed by Frank Lloyd Wright and built in 1924!

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead (In Color & Restored) (Edited Version)
programme.desc: This is one of the true cult classics and one of the scariest movies of all time. The dead are walking and hunger for human flesh. A group of panicked survivors are barricaded in a deserted farmhouse while the army of flesh eating zombies hovers outside their door. This over-the-top disk includes a restored original black and white version, and a color version that will thrill the horror film fan and horrify the film purist. programme.desc: The most famous serial killer (Ted Bundy), who may have killed 40 women, was only convicted because of an odontologist's being able to match his teeth with a bite mark on a victim in Florida.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1993, a 74-year-old man is found suffocated in his home with his checkbook, credit cards and vehicle stolen. Investigators flagged the dead man's credit cards and were alerted that they had been used by the killers. With this information, FBI agents were able to link the crime to an escaped prisoner and his girlfriend.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An innocent Milwaukee teen was kidnapped by four gunmen who demanded $30,000 from his family to guarantee his safe return. The victim's family contacted police and the FBI was brought in to help retrieve the boy and bring the violent kidnappers to justice.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In December 1981, a New Jersey State Trooper was shot to death on the side of Interstate 80. Fingerprints on the suspect's vehicle pointed to a fugitive wanted on bank robbery charges.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1980s, an illegal drug operation known as the K Street Crew opened its doors in Washington, DC. Leader Vincent Hill ran the organization with an iron fist that included intimidation and murder. Life in the city became more violent for everyone - gang member or not - so the FBI and local police created a joint task force to put an end to their deadly dealings.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 2000 the FBI was overwhelmed with investigations in Seattle, which had the third-highest number of bank robberies in the nation. Agents focused on a series of heists in which two heavily armed men seemed to know where the banks stored their money.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A bank vault was blasted into from the ceiling, and over $2 million in valuables was missing. Agents were able to track down one of the robbers' friends and attempted to use him as bait to reel in the crooks.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After an Arkansas State Trooper is shot and killed, officers catch the murderer and alert the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives when they find weapons and explosives in the man's vehicle. Testing of the weapons leads them to a racist, anti-Semitic paramilitary group. Agents surround the group's compound but the members resist for several days in a nail-biting standoff.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1992, a Washington, DC professor was shot and killed as she tried to get into her car, the latest incident in a series of violent carjackings. One week later, a man robbed a bank and security cameras captured the same vehicle as the getaway car.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.sub-title: FBI Files: The Atlanta Prison Riot
programme.desc: In 1987, Cuban prisoners at the Atlanta Federal Prison broke out homemade weapons and stole handcuffs and radios from prison staff. Soon, the inmates controlled most of the central buildings, taking more than 100 hostages. The FBI was forced to negotiate with hostile prisoners to end the standoff.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.sub-title: FBI Files: No Place to Hide
programme.desc: In the spring of 1997, a killer preyed on senior citizens in the quiet town of River Parish, Louisiana. Victims were robbed, beaten, shot and left for dead. FBI agents soon connected the violent crimes to an area mechanic with a gambling problem.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1996, a series of bank robberies in Texas baffled authorities. But when similar thefts occurred the next year in California, FBI agents linked the crimes and established a modus operandi. Another year later, the robbers took hostages during a violent heist in Las Vegas and the FBI was tasked with stopping these criminals once and for all.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In a suburb of Las Vegas, two robbers brandishing assault rifles ambushed an armored car, killing both guards and seizing thousands of dollars. Authorities were able to link the crime to a series of armed robberies on gambling houses, including the MGM Grand Hotel and Casino. Their main suspect was a recently paroled man with a history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1997, two men used a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, New Jersey home. Police tracked the suspects to a nearby park but the criminals were able to escape after a nearly fatal shootout. One year after the original crime, the FBI was called in when new clues emerged regarding the location of the suspects.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: This special episode examines previous cases to learn about the investigative techniques and innovations used by the FBI.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, a Croatian terrorist group linked to the National Resistance party committed acts against non-supportive Croatians living in the United States. With the help of an informant, the FBI apprehended, arrested and convicted members of the group of crimes ranging from conspiracy and extortion to murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1994, a rash of home invasions plagued the Detroit area. Each time, masked men disguised as police officers broke in with assault rifles and stole money and jewelry. But when one homeowner shot back, the identity of the intruders was revealed.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In June 1985, a Lebanese terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian Flight 405 shortly before take off in Beirut. Several American citizens were on board. The FBI opened a criminal investigation and worked with various other government agencies to form Operation Goldenrod, a task force charged with bringing the terrorist mastermind to justice.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An escapee from Castro's Cuba was the mastermind behind a secret terrorist organization called Omega 7. This group sought to carry out their mission through bombings and assassinations, financing their crimes through extortion and by assisting drug traffickers.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1990s Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power led to a full-scale mob war. Using informants and high-tech surveillance, the FBI infiltrated the most powerful mob family in the city and sought to bring down the organization before its own civil war lead to any innocent casualties.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.sub-title: FBI Files: The Great Philly Mob War
programme.desc: In 1990s Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power led to a full-scale mob war. Using informants and high-tech surveillance, the FBI infiltrated the most powerful mob family in the city and sought to bring down the organization before its own civil war lead to any innocent casualties.

programme.title: American Empire
programme.desc: This epic of America's westward march stars Leo Carrillo and Preston Foster in a tale of men building a cattle empire, only to battle rustlers, the weather, and each other! The romantic adventure from director William C. McGann (In Old California, Alcatraz Island) features a strong leading performance by Oscar nominated RKO star Richard Dix (Cimarron, The Ghost Ship) plus cinematography by six-time Oscar nominee Russell Harlan (To Kill a Mockingbird, Rio Bravo).

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Call of the Forest
programme.desc: There's plenty of drama in this tale of lost gold mines, gallant stallions, and fuzzy bears. Starring Ken Curtis, Robert Lowery, and Chief Thundercloud, this charming little film is highlighted by Karl Struss' stunning photography

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: Mason of the Mounted
programme.desc: Canadian Mountie Mason is sent south of the border to look for a horse thief with only a watch chain for evidence. He befriends young Andy and when Calhoun hits Andy, Mason and Calhoun fight. In the scuffle Calhoun's watch with the missing chain is dislodged. Mason then sets out to bring in Calhoun and his gang.

programme.title: The Gay Cavalier
programme.desc: The Cisco Kid, along with Pancho, try to help an unhappy bride.

programme.title: Crashing Thru
programme.desc: Down the danger trail sweeps a crimson fury... as Renfrew rides again! In this action-packed adventure, Sgt. Renfrew must face off against a group of criminals involved in a gold robbery. With his partner, Constable Kelly, wounded in a gunfight, Renfrew must stop the thieves on his own. Directed by Elmer Clifton; starring James Newill and Warren Hull, this is one adventure you won't want to miss!

programme.title: Sunset Carson Rides Again
programme.desc: Sunset Carson is trying to raise money for a new school and his partner Sam Webster is out to stop him. When Carson plans a benefit prize-fight, Webster plans to make off with the proceeds. Direted by Oliver Drake; starring Sunset Carson, Al Terry, Pat Starling, Ron Ormond, Joe Hiser.

programme.title: Texas Brooklyn and Heaven
programme.desc: When Eddie Tayloe (Guy Madison, 5 Against the House) receives $6,000 from his grandfather, he decides to leave his drab newspaper job and move to New York. His dream is to have a play produced on Broadway. Along the way he picks up a pretty hitchhiker (Diana Lynn, The Miracle of Morgan's Creek) who is also leaving her own dreary life for a shot at New York. Unfortunately, they find that the Big Apple is a hard place to make a living. But it's also a city where circumstances keep bringing them together!

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne plays a man wrongly convicted of murder in this exciting western drama from Lone Star Pictures. You'll enjoy plenty of gun action and thundering hoofbeats as he escapes from jail and then joins a gang, hoping to find the real killer! Director Armand Schaefer (The Miracle Rider, The Lost Jungle) whips up some fine performances from a cast of B-movie favorites, including Lane Chandler (Samson and Delilah) and the great stunt rider, Yakima Canutt. And of course, the film features plenty of fight scenes, made memorable by John Wayne's big swinging' right fist! For film buffs: This was one of 11 films Wayne starred in that year, making 1933 one of the busiest years of Wayne's legendary career.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: Daughter of the West
programme.desc: A FLAMING PAGE FROM AMERICAN HISTORY Becomes a powerful motion picture...set against the panoramic grandeur of the West!. Martha Vickers stars as Lolita Moreno, a convent raised woman in the 1880s who learns about her Native American heritage through her relationship with an educated Navajo. Morena had been raised at a California mission, but when she leaves to teach school in Arizona, the threads of her mysterious past are revealed. This leads to her involvement with some dangerous people, and a chance to find love in the most unexpected way. The cast includes Phillip Reed, Donald Woods, William Farnum and Milton Kibbee. Pedro de Cordobaa stars as Chief Wykomas.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Pursuit of Happiness Part 1"
programme.desc: Bhutan embraces happiness above all else for its citizens. This approach has made Bhutan a model for health around the world. Is happiness the key to better health?

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "The Pursuit of Happiness Part 2"
programme.desc: Mike learns what happiness means to the people of Bhutan. He visits a school and a rural farm and learns how happiness is integrated into day-to-day life and leaves a note for his father at the famous Tigers Nest temple.

programme.title: Health Explored S1 - "Forest Bathing"

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Cyborg"

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon grapples with girl power when he takes on an intimate family-run restaurant in the heart of WAG territory near Liverpool.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon comes to rescue Ruby Tates, a fancy oyster bar in Brighton burdened by a soft owner, lackadaisical chefs and no leadership.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon visits The Priory, Haywards Heath, owned by ex-IT consultant Scott. The restaurant is in a spectacularly beautiful location and offers bargain roast dinners from a carvery that's been running for twenty years. With an ageing clientele who eat for half-price, Scott's losing 5,000 a week. The food is straight from hell: recycled meat, soup in a bucket, synthetic sauces and, worse still, a lazy head chef content to preside over food-encrusted ovens and a disaffected brigade.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon visits Paris to aid a petite vegetarian restaurant in the heart of a meat-loving country but winds up working it alone thanks to a lazy boss hemorrhaging staff.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon visits the Curry Lounge in Nottingham, the city with more restaurants per square mile than any other in Britain. This 110-seater Indian restaurant has been run since January by ex-sales director Raz who's new to the business - and it shows. Despite a 500,000 refurbishment, and dcor like a Bollywood set, the honeymoon period's well and truly over. His once-healthy trade is evaporating and, at his current rate of loss, it's uncertain he'll make it past Christmas.

programme.title: Gordon Behind Bars - Clean
programme.desc: He arrives at Brixton Prison in south London packed with drug dealers, burglars, muggers and thieves - some very unsavoury characters. First Gordon needs to pick 12 men for his Bad Boys Brigade business, but none of them can even scramble an egg. After baking some cupcakes with the prisoners, Gordon discovers some of them are handy with icing and glitter. But as the Brigade start arguing among themselves, Gordon sets them a challenge: to cook dinner for the whole prison.

programme.title: Gordon Behind Bars - Clean
programme.desc: Gordon has chosen his Bad Boys Brigade to work for his prison business, and now he has to trust the prisoners with sharp knives.

programme.title: Gordon Behind Bars - Clean
programme.desc: Gordon's been at Brixton Prison for two months and it's time his Bad Boy Bakery business started bringing in some proper money. The kitchen brigade is already two men down and facing the challenges from the prison system is beginning to take its toll on Gordon. He has a row with burglar Rene and his local gourmet lunch delivery service doesn't work out as planned.

programme.title: Gordon Behind Bars - Clean
programme.desc: Gordon's served almost six months in Brixton Prison, but it will mean nothing if he doesn't leave a viable business behind to keep prisoners working and earning. For the Bad Boys Bakery to stay open long term, he has to get a big coffee chain to bulk buy his lemon curd treacle slice. A combination of a branding guru and the prisoners themselves package the slice for the socially conscious consumer. And Gordon persuades Caffe Nero to stock it for a 'make or break' showcase week.

programme.title: Gordon's Great Escape
programme.desc: In tonights first programme, Gordons odyssey begins in the north, home of our curry house classics. On board an express train hes thrown in at the deep end and experiences a back-to basics baptism of fire, cooking for its many passengers in the trains cramped pantry car and getting travel sick while hes making curry. In stark contrast he then meets his match working for a cantankerous royal chef, preparing a biryani with a difference for a huge wedding feast before venturing into the jungle where he gets eaten alive by ants when he scales a 40-foot tree in search of the local tribes favourite delicacy. Then its on to Delhi to cook at the restaurant that invented tandoori chicken, where Gordon puts into practice everything hes learnt for a tough crowd of Delhi food critics.

programme.title: Gordon's Great Escape
programme.desc: In tonights second programme Gordons got a taste for adventure and heads off the tourist track into impenetrable north-east India, home of the countrys best-kept culinary secrets. Leaving the 21st century behind, he immerses himself in the life of a local meat-loving tribe in Nagaland, once better known for head-hunting than their curries. Then hes off to Assam to enter a housewives competition to find the best Assamese dish; and finally he sets up shop among the street food stalls of Calcutta to try and tempt the local foodies into buying north-east curry Ramsay style.

programme.title: Gordon's Great Escape
programme.desc: In tonights final programme Gordon heads south to the coasts of Kerala for the ultimate seafood curry. In Tamil Naduhe hits a meat-free zone and faces his biggest culinarynightmare, living in an ashram where the only food on the menu is vegetarian. Any tranquillity soon evaporates when Gordon tries his highest-octane sport yet - bullock racing - before his final stop in the slums of Mumbai. There he cooks on Slumdog Millionaire streets before putting himself to the ultimate test, cooking alongside one of India's top chefs for a star-studded dinner at the Taj Hotel.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Shark Bait
programme.desc: The shark is one of the most extraordinary creatures on earth terrifying, beautiful and, for many, delicious. Fascinated by both how it is caught, and how it is consumed, Gordon explores the shark fishing industry, the history and culture behind shark fin soup, as well as the increasing demand for shark meat. But with shark numbers in decline he asks whether shark is a dish that needs to come off our menus for good.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon visits Mayfair, a restaurant with a prime location on the busy seafront in Fuengirola, Costa del Sol. With thousands of hungry sun seekers right on its doorstep, the restaurant should be raking it in but the place is totally empty. Gordon discovers multiple fridges and freezers filled with tat and a kitchen brimming with microwaves. Gordon struggles with a venue and staff that plumb new depths of despair.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon visits struggling Le Deck restaurant in South West France. Despite every effort, the restaurant is running at a loss of fifty thousand a year. While the neighbouring French restaurants are thriving, Le Deck boasts more staff than customers. Massive overheads and chaotic leadership mean owners Tim and Debbie are watching Le Deck head for the rocks. Debbie begs Tim to walk away from the restaurant but he stubbornly refuses.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: In a series first, Gordon is tackling a brand new up-market start up restaurant, La Granada Divino, its only been open for 8 weeks but is already heading for disaster. Owners Milan and Gina have never run a restaurant and have sunk their savings and retirement fund in to the place.Gordon is told the ex-head chef of celebrated London restaurants Scotts and Fifth Floor Harvey Nichols is in the kitchen, so is shocked by the confused and dated menu, until he carries out some background checks.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits a Caribbean style resort hotel in Fort Pierce, Florida where the young inexperienced owner, Brian is making guests time at the hotel miserable with filthy rooms, late night concerts and shocking service. Brian has lost control, leaving the hotel staff to run wild. Gordon quickly realizes hes going to need something short of a miracle if hes going to stop this place from going under water.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Island Park, Idaho to try and rescue the failing Anglers Lodge. Despite building the stunning lodge with his own hands, owner Dave Ebey has lost his passion and it has almost cost him his business. Gordon discovers a family tragedy has devastated the Ebeys and caused them to shy away from the hotel and the community. Gordon is desperate to help this couple at their breaking point but is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Harpers Ferry in West Virginia, to try to save a historic hotel thats desperately in need of help. Karan Townsend, the owner, runs the hotel like a thrift store and hoards junk everywhere. Under Karans management the business and the hotel have started to fall apart. Gordon gets the shock of his life as he witnesses the worst dinner service he has ever had the misfortune to see. This disaster of a hotel could be too much for even Gordon Ramsay to save.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon continues his mission to fix the failing Towns Inn in Harpers Ferry, West Virginia despite having to shut down the hotel after witnessing some shocking food practices. These are some of the worst Ramsay has encountered; some so serious they threaten the lives of the guests, as well as the life of the hotel. Gordon is left in even more disbelief as he uncovers some even more terrifying cleanliness issues.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: The Vienna owners Jonathan and Lisa Krach are at their breaking point and have become trapped in their Austrian themed hotel, drowning in debt. Gordon discovers some shocking rumors about the owners and the real reason customers have stopped coming to the European inspired Inn. Can Gordon keep the doors to this historic hotel open, or is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Cambridge, New York, where ex-military man John Imhof and his wife, Tina, own and run the allegedly haunted Cambridge Hotel. General John runs the hotel like a dictatorship, an approach thats driving the staff crazy and the guests straight out the door. Gordons stay at the hotel is genuinely terrifying, but its not the ghost that keeps him awake, its something far worse.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits The Keating, a luxury boutique hotel in San Diego, CA. The Keatings supercar-obsessed owner, Eddie Kaen, has blown millions designing the hotel to look like an Italian sports car, but neglected to spend money on things the guests really need. The rooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing and the staff have reached their limit, leading to a truly shocking crisis that no one saw coming.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to The River Rock Inn in Milford Pennsylvania, where owner Ken Pisciotta is over his head and drowning in debt. Unable to get any guests to stay in his neglected inn, Ken has all but given up, and his constant negativity is making the entire staff question whether lifes too short to continue working there. Can Gordon get the River Rock back on track before Ken loses everything?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to the Juniper Hill Inn in Windsor, VT, a place that looks like a million dollars but smells of raw sewage. He meets the inns wealthy and arrogant owner, Robert Dean II, and uncovers his shocking treatment of his staff. Gordon quickly realizes its going to need something approaching a miracle if hes going to have a chance of saving this place.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Its Gordons greatest challenge to date, as he continues to uncover problem after problem at Vermonts Juniper Hill Inn. He tries to help the staff against arrogant owners Robert and Ari, but after catching one of them in a shocking lie, Gordon feels he has no choice but to do something hes never done before. Abandon ship.

programme.title: Stanley on the Go
programme.desc: Stanley Siegel, the late broadcaster, known to millions for his groundbreaking and often controversial interviews on WABC-and with Stanley On The Go he single-handedly redefines the travel show. Indeed, he redefines the notion of adventure: you don't have to be a young Olympian to have a zest for life. Experience shouldn't - and doesn't - end at 60. Stanley shows that there's more to retirement than bingo and shuffleboard on the Lido deck. He's an inspiration. Stanley takes us headlong around the globe: whether he's on a camel in Giza, the deck of a Navy aircraft carrier off San Diego, straddling a speeding motorbike through the streets of Moscow, or balancing on top of the Sydney Harbor Bridge, each episode is a tour de force with a force of nature. Stanley is irrepressible, his commentary is not only informative and enlightening, but is also often surprising and frequently irreverent. He shows us the iconic sights-the Grand Tour-but also uncovers the unexpected.

programme.title: Larry Graham - Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tony Bennett - Maybe this time
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London’s Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect. Bennett is accompanied by his musical director Torrie Zito and an orchestra of British musicians that includes Kenny Clare (drums), Don Lusher (trombone), and Kenny Baker (trumpet). Tune in for Bennett’s captivating take on songs “The Good Things in Life”, “My Favorite Things”, “My Love”, “I’ve Got Five Dollars”, “It Don’t Mean a Thing”, and “Maybe This Time” in this magical concert recording.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter - Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane - Vigil
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: James Brown - James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. The "Godfather of Soul", "Mr. Dynamite", and "Soul Brother No. 1" was a major force in 20th century popular music, influencing many musicians in numerous genres.

programme.title: Christian McBride - Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Le Quatuor Ebène - Jacques Loussier in Leipzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: In 1959, Jacques Loussier hit upon the idea that was to make his international reputation, by combining his interest in jazz with his love of J.S. Bach. Only a pianist with such an exceptional classical technique and deft improvisatory skill could have nurtured such a vision. He founded the Play Bach Trio, which used Bach's compositions as the basis for jazz improvisation. The trio immediately caught the public imagination. In their live appearances, tours and concerts, plus a succession of recordings built on the cornerstone of four albums made between 1960 and 1963, Loussier's group achieved the breakthrough to popular commercial success enjoyed by only a select few jazz musicians. In fifteen years, the trio sold over six million albums! On July 28th 2004, the day of Bach's 254th anniversary of death, the Jacques Loussier Trio perform a special concert at the famous St. Thomas Church of Leipzig - the city where Bach composed many of his most famous works.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius - Fannie Mae
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius’s electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Art Farmer, Jim Hall, Steve Swallow & Pete La Roca - The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64 highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer’s band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins’ band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Bill Evans - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Seun Kuti - Seun Kuti & Egypt 80 - Cabaret Sauvage
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti’s legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent. Three-quarters of Egypt 80's current line-up is composed of musicians who didn’t only play with Fela Kuti, but often were arrested and harassed alongside the founder of the Afrobeat.

programme.title: Paul Desmond - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: James Brown - James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. programme.title: Christian McBride - Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Makoto Ozone - Makoto Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1984, Japanese jazz pianist Makoto Ozone was one of the artists appearing here. Having recently graduated from Berklee College of Music in Boston, Massachusetts, USA, Ozone performed a mesmerizing solo concert for the festival’s audience. Today, Ozone is among the most recognized Japanese jazz musicians in the world.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn - Betty Carter/Jazzmeia Horn, Please Do Something
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn’s concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Chick Corea, John Patitucci & Dave Weckl - Chick Corea Akoustic Band - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1989, American pianist Armando Anthony "Chick" Corea was one of the artists appearing here. In this concert Corea returned to his roots, performing jazz standards and originals in a stripped-down trio setting of piano, bass and drums. With Dave Weckl (drums) and John Patitucci (bass), this highly interactive trio actually had its beginnings in 1985 with Chick Corea's Elektric Band.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés - Lorena's Tango
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá’. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés’ piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés’s band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: John Coltrane - I want to talk about you
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Al Di Meola, Chris Carrington & Arto Tuncboyaciyan - Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here. With second guitarist Chris Carrington and percussionist Arto Tunçboyacıyan, Meola performs the now-classic world-fusion repertoire from his album 'World Sinfonia', which was originally released in 1991.

programme.title: ZZ Top - Live at Montreux
programme.desc: With an unchanged line-up stretching back to 1969 and global album sales in excess of 50 million, ZZ Top continue to delight fans around the world with brilliant live concerts and great music. The band has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies albums such as "Tres Hombres" and "Fandango" through their eighties blockbuster period with "Eliminator" and "Afterburner" and up to their most recent release and return to their blues roots with "La Futura". The middle section of the concert features a jazz-blues tribute to the late Montreux Festival founder Claude Nobs with guest appearances by Mike Flanigin on Hammond Organ and Van Wilks on guitar. ZZ Top, the "lil’ ol’ band from Texas", are rocking the blues as strongly as ever! Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Guns N' Roses - Live From The O2 Arena London
programme.desc: Watch this mega-production of Guns N’ Roses performing live at the O2 Arena to its fans singing and vibrating to each song. Includes; Paradise City, Sweet Child O’ Mine, November Rain and many more.

programme.title: Sting - Bring On The Night
programme.desc: Documents the preparation and rehearsals for Sting's first solo concert, as well as his supporting band's opinions on their leader and his controversial efforts.

programme.title: Tony Bennett - Duets II: The Great Performances
programme.desc: Duets II: The Great Performances is a visually stunning video companion to Tony Bennett's history-making #1 album, Duets II. The concert features the full song performances from Tony and today's greatest artists as they were recorded live in the studio. The musical segments are enhanced by insights on the process from Tony and the duet partners, providing an inside look at this landmark album in an unprecedented career. Duets II: The Great Performances is a testament to the artistry and dedication of Tony Bennett, beloved by the performers who sing with him and audiences around the world. Starring Andrea Bocelli, Michael Bublé, Natalie Cole, Sheryl Crow, Aretha Franklin, Josh Groban, Faith Hill, Norah Jones, Lady Gaga, kd lang, John Mayer, Willie Nelson, Alejandro Sanz, Queen Latifah, Carrie Underwood, Amy Winehouse.

programme.title: Bruce Springsteen - Live in Hyde Park
programme.desc: London Calling: Live in Hyde Park is a concert video of Bruce Springsteen & the E Street Band's performance during the Hard Rock Calling music festival in Hyde Park, London on June 28, 2009.

programme.title: Robert Plant - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette - Live at Montreux 2012
programme.desc: Alanis Morissette is one of the most successful female artists and songwriters of all time and has sold in excess of 60 million albums worldwide. Her voice is instantly recognisable and she is a consummate live performer. On 2 July 2012 Alanis Morissette returned to Montreux as part of her Guardian Angel Tour in support of her latest album "Havoc And Bright Lights". It was her third appearance at the festival. The set showcased a number of tracks from the new album alongside classic tracks from across her career. Music video by Alanis Morissette __© 2012 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: The Who - Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle. As the evening shadows lengthened across the festival site, The Who took to the stage and delivered an incendiary performance packed with hit singles and classic album tracks and the concert more than lived up to the fan’s expectations and memories of 1970.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. "Kodachrome," "Mother and Child Reunion," "Gone At Last" and "The Obvious Child" are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including "Dazzling Blue," "Rewrite," "The Afterlife" and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers - Live At Wolf Trap
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, "Live At Wolf Trap" captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue. This would prove to be the last recorded footage of long time drummer Keith Knudsen performing with the Doobie Brothers prior to his sad death from cancer in February 2005.
